verdict.rationale: Convertio offers a public developer API with keys, a CLI and official wrappers, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows one exists: probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. API keys, a CLI and SDK wrappers are adjacent building blocks, not a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
